name: belisoful/prado-privacy
description: Privacy compliance for PRADO: consent management, data subject rights, retention and records of processing (GDPR, UK GDPR/PECR, ePrivacy, CCPA/CPRA).

suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: The consent log, the database consent store, the privacy request log and retention purges without a configured database connection.
suggest.maxmind-db/reader: Locating visitors from a local MaxMind DB file (GeoLite2, GeoIP2, DB-IP Lite, IPinfo, IP2Location) with TMaxMindDbLocator.
suggest.belisoful/ganalytics: Google Analytics 4 with Consent Mode driven by TConsentModule (its GAnalyticsPrivacyConsentProvider).

scripts-descriptions.lint: Compile-check every PHP file under src/ and tests/ with php -l.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply php-cs-fixer to src/ and tests/.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Check code style without changing files (what CI runs).
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the level in phpstan.neon.dist.
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Run the unit tests with a text coverage report (Xdebug).
scripts-descriptions.coverage-html: Run the unit tests with an HTML coverage report in build/coverage.
scripts-descriptions.coverage-paths: Run the unit tests with Xdebug path coverage and a text summary.
scripts-descriptions.coverage-branches: List every unexecuted branch under src/; narrow with -- --filter <Test> --coverage-filter src/<Class>.php.
scripts-descriptions.integration: Install the package into a throwaway consumer project and verify the extra.prado wiring.
scripts-descriptions.fulltest: The full check: lint, code style, static analysis, unit tests, in that order.
